name: docs-squad-orchestrator
description: Answers developer questions about the example SDK (Client methods, parameters, defaults, v2 vs v3 differences) by delegating to a version/deprecation worker and a code-sample worker, then writing one answer grounded in the reference documentation, with chunk-id citations. Week 10 design: this card is what the orchestrator would advertise; the build in app/rag/week10_squad.py serves its workers over plain local HTTP, not A2A.

bearer.description: Caller token, scoped per skill. The local build has no authentication; a deployment would need it before exposing the squad.

skills.name: Answer an SDK documentation question
skills.description: One question in, one answer out, in the ANSWER / VERSION / CITATIONS contract. Every claim comes from the v2/v3 reference documentation or the package registry; when they do not contain the answer, the reply is INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT. When a worker fails, the task cannot complete as asked (see report/w10/a2a.md).
examples: What is the default value of retry_backoff_ms on Client.send() in v3?
did chunk_size change between v2 and v3
